help.description: A node that executes Ruby code using WebAssembly runtime.
help.inputPayload: The Ruby code to execute. If not provided, the code from the node's configuration will be used.
help.outputPayload: The result of the executed Ruby code as a string.
help.detailsText: This node uses @ruby/wasm-wasi to run Ruby code within Node-RED using WebAssembly. You can write your Ruby script directly in the built-in code editor with syntax highlighting.
help.sandboxInfo: The Ruby code will be executed in a sandboxed WebAssembly environment. The result of the last expression or explicit return will be converted to a string and set as the output payload.

errors.notString: Input code is not a string.
